user_input: I forgot my password, how can I reset it?
reference: Go to https://passwords.novatech.com, click Forgot Password, enter your employee ID, verify with the one-time code and set a new password. If locked out call IT on extension 2020.

user_input: How long does my account stay locked after too many wrong passwords?
reference: After 5 failed attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes and then unlocks automatically; call extension 2020 for faster help.

user_input: What are the password complexity rules?
reference: At least 12 characters with an upper-case letter, a number and a symbol; you cannot reuse your last 5 passwords; passwords expire every 90 days.

user_input: My laptop is asking for a BitLocker recovery key
reference: Do not reinstall anything; call extension 2020 and IT will read the recovery key to you after identity verification.

user_input: How do I connect to the company VPN from home?
reference: Open GlobalProtect, enter portal vpn.novatech.com, sign in with SSO credentials and approve the Okta Verify push.

user_input: VPN is connected but internal sites won't open
reference: Disconnect, flush DNS (ipconfig /flushdns on Windows or sudo dscacheutil -flushcache on macOS) and reconnect.

user_input: Can I use the VPN on my personal laptop?
reference: No. Personal devices are not allowed to connect to the VPN; only company-managed laptops with GlobalProtect.

user_input: I'm getting a new phone, how do I move Okta Verify?
reference: Before wiping the old phone, sign in at https://novatech.okta.com, go to Settings > Security Methods, set up Okta Verify on the new phone, then remove the old device.

user_input: Who needs a YubiKey?
reference: Engineers with production access and Finance staff must register a YubiKey, requested via the IT Service Catalog under Hardware > Security Key.

user_input: How do I get a Figma licence?
reference: Raise a Software Request in the IT Service Catalog with justification; manager approval is needed. Figma is for design and product teams; others need manager justification.

user_input: Can I install Docker Desktop without raising a request?
reference: Yes, Docker Desktop is pre-approved and can be installed from NovaTech Software Center or Self Service.

user_input: Is it okay to install a torrent client on my work laptop?
reference: No, torrent clients are prohibited on company devices.

user_input: A candidate is visiting tomorrow, how do they get Wi-Fi?
reference: Create a guest pass at https://wifi.novatech.com/guest; the visitor receives a voucher code and connects to NovaTech-Guest.

user_input: Can I use the iPhone Mail app for work email?
reference: No, the iOS Mail app is blocked; use the official Gmail app with Google Device Policy.

user_input: How often are laptops refreshed?
reference: Every 3 years; IT emails you 30 days before the refresh date.

user_input: I'm joining remotely, when will my laptop arrive?
reference: Remote joiners receive the laptop by courier 2 working days before the joining date.

user_input: How many sick days am I entitled to?
reference: Up to 48 hours (6 days) of sick and safe time per year, accrued at 1 hour per 30 hours worked under Minnesota ESST.

user_input: Do unused sick days carry over to next year?
reference: Yes, unused sick and safe time carries over, with the total balance capped at 80 hours; it is not paid out when you leave.

user_input: How much PTO can I carry over into next year?
reference: Up to 5 days of unused PTO can be carried over; anything above 5 days is forfeited on 31 December.

user_input: How many weeks of parental leave does a non-birthing parent get?
reference: 12 weeks at full pay for any new parent, taken within 12 months of birth, adoption or foster placement.

user_input: I worked last Sunday, can I get a day off for it?
reference: Yes, salaried employees earn a substitute day off per full day worked; apply on PeopleHub within 7 days and use it within 60 days. Hourly employees are paid overtime instead.

user_input: Which days do I have to come to the office?
reference: 3 days a week; Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday are the anchor days.

user_input: Can I work remotely from Dubai for a month?
reference: Working from outside the United States is not allowed without prior approval from HR and Legal.

user_input: Is my home internet bill reimbursed?
reference: Yes, up to $50 per month after the introductory period, claimed on PeopleHub with receipts.

user_input: What's the process to claim my travel expenses?
reference: On PeopleHub, Expenses > New Claim, enter details, upload receipts and submit within 30 days; manager then Finance approve.

user_input: What's the hotel budget per night in New York?
reference: $250 per night in high-cost cities such as New York.

user_input: A vendor sent me a gift basket worth $150. Can I keep it?
reference: Gifts are allowed up to $100 per year per partner; anything above must be declined or declared to Compliance.

user_input: Where do I file a sexual harassment complaint?
reference: Report to HR Employee Relations at er@novatech.com, your HR Business Partner or any manager, or anonymously through the Ethics Hotline.

user_input: When do merit increases take effect after the review?
reference: Merit increases take effect from 1 April and appear in the first paycheck after that date.

user_input: What time should I report on my joining day?
reference: Report to reception at 9:30 AM.

user_input: Can I add my domestic partner to my health insurance?
reference: Yes, a spouse or domestic partner and children up to age 26 can be covered; NovaTech pays 75% of dependant premiums.

user_input: What is the notice period if I resign?
reference: Employment is at-will; NovaTech asks for 2 weeks' notice (4 weeks for managers and above).

user_input: When do I get paid?
reference: Every other Friday by direct deposit, or the Thursday before if that Friday is a bank holiday.

user_input: When will I get my W-2?
reference: Your W-2 for the previous year is published on PeopleHub by 31 January.

user_input: Explain the vesting cliff for my stock options
reference: Options vest over 4 years with a 1-year cliff: nothing vests in the first 12 months, 25% vests on the first anniversary, then the rest quarterly over 3 years.

user_input: How much does NovaTech match on my 401(k)?
reference: NovaTech matches 100% of the first 4% you contribute plus 50% of the next 2%, up to 5% of eligible pay.
